cases.prompt: Refactor this 10,000-item Flutter catalog so layout is driven by available constraints, compact and expanded widths do not overflow, and rows remain lazily materialized. Preserve the public CatalogApp entrypoint and verify the result.
cases.target: CatalogApp uses constraint-driven compact and expanded branches, a lazy builder for the 10,000-item collection, no eager UI materialization, and no overflow.

cases.prompt: Launch the Flutter app with the real Dart/Flutter MCP server, inspect its runtime widget tree and runtime errors, exercise the increment action, and report concise evidence. Do not claim a tool result you did not observe.
cases.target: The response reports evidence from a real Dart/Flutter MCP invocation, identifies Runtime probe and Count widgets, checks runtime errors, and observes the counter interaction.

cases.prompt: Make TaskCard reusable and preview-safe. The widget must accept immutable presentation values and a pure callback; its @Preview closure must use only synthetic immutable data and must not reach files, network, plugins, adapters, globals, or app lifecycle. Preserve TaskCard and previewTaskCard and verify them.
cases.target: TaskCard accepts values and a VoidCallback, previewTaskCard displays Synthetic task from immutable synthetic data, and the preview source has no native I/O, network, or plugin reachability.

cases.prompt: Refactor the task feature to MVVM. Define a provider-neutral TaskRepository with load(), make TasksViewModel extend ChangeNotifier and own loading state, let TasksPage accept the ViewModel and own route lifecycle, and make a reusable TasksView accept only presentation values and callbacks. Keep Task, TasksPage, TasksViewModel, TasksView, and TaskRepository public and verify the result.
cases.target: The repository supplies data, TasksViewModel owns state, TasksPage owns lifecycle, TasksView is value/callback-only, and no remote service or domain mutation is initiated by reusable widgets.

cases.prompt: Correct the provider-neutral local-first repository. LocalFirstTaskRepository must coordinate its remote and exactly one TaskStore selected by composition, save locally before remote delivery, and enqueue when delivery fails. MemoryTaskStore, DriftTaskStore, and ObjectBoxTaskStore must honor the same contract. Remove dual-write and automatic migration behavior and verify all three stores.
cases.target: Each store satisfies one TaskStore contract, local state is authoritative before remote delivery, offline work enters the selected store outbox, and there is no mirror, dual-write, or implicit migration path.

cases.prompt: Make the capability projection exhaustive and pure across supported, unsupported, permissionRequired, permissionDenied, temporarilyUnavailable, and providerFailure. Keep the existing public enum, projectCapability function, and CapabilityApp and verify every state without invoking a platform channel.
cases.target: Every CapabilityState has an explicit stable presentation string and the projection remains pure and platform-channel-free.

cases.prompt: Make CounterJourneyApp responsive and accessible, preserving count across compact-to-expanded resize. Give the increment control the exact tooltip Increment counter and keyboard activation. Add focused widget tests for interaction, resize state, semantics, and overflow, then run analysis and tests.
cases.target: Compact and expanded layouts have no overflow, count survives resize, the increment action is discoverable by tooltip and semantics, keyboard activation works, and widget tests cover the journey.
